description: Get a ready-to-fill unPaper HTML slide template. Use this FIRST when asked to create a presentation/deck/slides as .pptx or print-ready HTML: write your content INTO the returned file's structure (keep its <style>, @page and <script> blocks verbatim; one <section class="slide"> per slide; add data-unpaper-chart JSON to every chart; put speaker notes in <aside class="notes">). Then validate with `check` and convert with `convert`.
name: starter
